<tabber>Permanent Achievements=
{{Achievement|Vlad’s Little Helpers|jpg|Complete the [[White Xmas]] job on the Normal difficulty or above. Unlocks the “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Mrs. Claus]]” mask.}}
{{Achievement|Stealing Christmas|jpg|Complete the [[White Xmas]] job on the Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Strinch]]” mask.}}
{{Achievement|Cancelling Santa’s Christmas|jpg|Complete the [[White Xmas]] job on the Very Hard difficulty or above. Unlocks the “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Krampus]]” mask.}}
{{Achievement|Claustrophobia|jpg|Complete the [[White Xmas]] job on the OVERKILL difficulty or above. Unlocks the “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Mechanical Santa]]” mask.}}
{{Achievement|Like Turkeys Voting for an Early Christmas|jpg|Complete the [[White Xmas]] job on the Death Wish difficulty or above.}}
{{Achievement|Riders On the Snowstorm|jpg|In the [[White Xmas]] job, complete the heist on the Death Wish difficulty or above while each crew member wear a different “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal|2014 Xmas]]” mask each. Unlocks the “[[Masks (Payday 2)#Normal (Achievement)|Almir’s Beard]]” mask.}}
{{Achievement|Impossible, It Can't Be. Is It?|jpg|In the White Xmas job, secure the rare [[Loot#Loot bag values|Almir’s Toast]].}}

|-|Trivia=
* The teaser achievements are a reference to the song [[wikipedia:White Christmas (song)|White Christmas]] by [[wikipedia:Irving Berlin|Irving Berlin]].
* '''Stealing Christmas''' is a reference to the [[wikipedia:Dr. Seuss|Dr. Seuss]] book ''[[wikipedia:How the Grinch Stole Christmas!|How the Grinch Stole Christmas!]]'', as is the mask unlocked for completing it.
* '''Claustrophobia''' is a pun on Santa ''Claus''.
* The '''Riders on a Snowstorm''' achievement is a reference to the song [[wikipedia:Riders on the Storm|Riders on the Storm]] by [[wikipedia:The Doors|The Doors]].
